question: Does the 32-update checkpoint still beat Base on two fresh public word-problem sources when both receive four times the generation allowance?
selection: Seeded SHA256 order on normalized unique question text. Select 24 public GSM1K questions and six SVAMP items per each of four operation types. Exclude historical project texts, previous GSM training/development rows and duplicate questions. Interleave two sorted source lists. Freeze IDs, golds, prompt tokens and order before any neural scoring.
protocol: Same zero-demo thinking prompt and strict first-turn numeric scorer as the passing development study, K2 vs unadapted K1, unrestricted greedy. Balanced arm order: candidate first on first 24, Base first on last 24. Record tokens, per-item times, wins, losses, answers at full budget and descriptive 256-token prefix at the actual measured time. No tuning on this cohort. No new training.
gate: At the full 1024-token allowance require >=2 net wins in each source, pooled exact two-sided McNemar p<0.05, and total candidate generation time <= Base. Any loss of the prerequisite weight identity closes this study. On warning or budget interruption archive the completed prefix; no claim of replication.
